8,541 likes, 98 comments - divyankatripathidahiya on September 4, 2026: "Aptaclub India’s AI Poop Checker has made those “Is this normal?” moments feel a little less stressful. 💙

One twin pooped after every feed. The other, once every three days.

Naturally, I thought something was wrong. Turns out, both were absolutely fine!

Because baby poop doesn’t follow one timetable. Its frequency, colour and texture can change depending on age, feeding and simply from one baby to another.

The tricky part is knowing whether to relax, keep an eye on it or speak to an expert. Especially at 2 AM, when every Google search only adds to the panic. 😅

That’s why I use the AI Poop Checker on Aptaclub India. Just upload a photo to receive guidance based on the colour and texture, and connect with Aptaclub experts when you need more clarity.

#Ad #Aptaclub #AptaclubIndia #AIPoopChecker #BabyGutHealth BabyDigestion NewMom TwinMom".
